method: directed-A* minimum-cost paths on 26-neighbour eroded-hull graph; no gravity blend, no streamline-then-project
erosion_rule: hull occupancy distance-transform >= 3.0 mm (2 mm grid) AND exact-SDF >= 3.0 mm

roots.rule: greedy Poisson subset, crown-first order, adaptive spacing to land 300-500 roots

ear_plane_rule: y_ear_mm = median y of scalp hairline-loop points with |x| above the 80th percentile (sideburn anchor, data-driven); root world y < y_ear -> curtain family, else back family
endpoint_bands: per (sector, side): curtain-L/R (root x<0 / x>=0, y<y_ear), back-L/R (root x<0 / x>=0, y>=y_ear; pools overlap +-2 mm so bundles can meet at the occiput). Pool = x-binned (10 mm bins) lowest 25 eroded voxels per bin within z <= sector_min_z + 20 mm: a hem-spanning pool. Assignment is quantile-matched in lateral scalp order (member x-rank -> pool x-rank, local search outward from the quantile target biased to the bottom 6 mm of the slab (rank penalty max(0,z-(zmin+6))/3, so guides end at the hem, not mid-slab) with hard same-sign rule (endpoint_x * root_x >= 0), global x-monotonicity vs all previously assigned neighbours (no order flips), preferred endpoint spacing 4 mm (relax 2.5 mm) over a hard distinct-voxel floor (no endpoint voxel is ever shared: spacing >= 2 mm always, so roots cannot collapse into one channel). 6 mm is unsatisfiable: ~274 back guides share a ~170 mm hem; 4 mm still guarantees distinct-voxel channels on the 2 mm grid.
part_rule: w_part * len_mm added on nodes whose x-sign opposes the root's sign (roots |x|<3 mm exempt); keeps left hair left of the centre part without hard-blocking the midline
edge_cost: w_len*len_mm + w_up*max(0,dz_mm) + w_curve*turn_rad + w_body*bodyterm*len_mm + w_bnd*bndterm*len_mm + w_coh*min(usage,3)*len_mm (saturating coherence: the first paths through a node repel, an established channel stays cheap; w_coh = 1.0 because x-monotone endpoint assignment already carries neighbour coherence and usage is only anti-collapse; uncapped usage drives late-order roots past the expansion cap even though zero-usage paths exist and accept)
components: routing graph = largest 26-connected component of the eroded set (sliver labels dropped at graph build; count recorded)
w_curve_note: raised 6 -> 16 after the first gated run showed azimuthal circling (mean |azimuthal tangent| 0.45 in the crown band, guides0 rings 0.58): a diagonal shortcut across the dome saves length but pays continuous turn; 16 prices a quarter-turn of extra spiral above the corner-cutting saving while dome-following (turn ~0.03 rad/edge) stays affordable. Weight tuning inside the frozen six-term cost, not a new term.
heuristic: weighted A* (eps=3.0) on w_len * euclidean mm: all other terms non-negative so eps=1 is admissible; eps=3 bounds suboptimality x3 and keeps 250 mm crown-to-hem searches inside the expansion cap (calibration probe: unweighted A* exhausts 150k expansions on crown->hem, eps=3 finds it in 3639 expansions / 0.05 s; eps=2 needs 32960)
order: scalp order (y, x) with usage-map coherence; retry passes over unreachable roots at usage scales 1.0, 0.25, 0.0 (same cap, same acceptance) recover load casualties; levels recorded
smooth: centripetal Catmull-Rom through path nodes, 2 mm resample; fallback = collinear-decimated voxel polyline (always inside eroded hull, SDF>=3)
accept: routed portion (arc beyond the first 8 mm) must lie inside hull occupancy with exact-SDF > 0 (outside body) and arc fraction inside the eroded hull >= 0.95; the root leader (first 8 mm of arc, root-to-first-node attachment through the coverage rind) is exempt from hull/eroded containment because roots live <= 4.5 mm off the hull by hull0c construction, but must satisfy exact-SDF > -1 mm (not buried); leader length recorded and reported (p50/max; long leaders traverse non-eroded hull under the same acceptance check)
